text:
Maria: Heads-up — planning a deploy in the 02:00 UTC change window. We’re gating a routing change behind feature flag `llm_route_v2`. Plan is a curtain-raise: 0% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with ~20m soak per step and session drain between steps. Thoughts?

Leo: Sounds good. What are the concrete rollback triggers?

Sam: Keep it simple: latency p95 +120ms vs baseline OR error-rate +0.5% absolute OR request-drop rate +0.2%. If any gate trips, deploy-bot should pin traffic back to v1 and drain v2.

Dana: +1. Also recommend pinning the model variant for both sides during the rollout window (eg `model_v1_locked` for 2h after each step) so we don't get drift. Session affinity TTL down to 5m during ramp to avoid long-lived kv cache issues.

Maria: Good call about affinity. I'll add that to release notes. Also add a short rollback blurb for SRE on-call: exact deploy-bot commands and where logs live.

Ben: Quick ops snippet to run when ready:`/deploybot ff set llm_route_v2 --percent 5 --cohort curtain --actor @deploy-bot` follow with health-check:`/deploybot ff health llm_route_v2 --wait 1200`

deploy-bot: queued action acknowledged — I will only apply shifts after manual START or when the preflight passes. I will emit a timestamped health-check summary on each step. :gear:

Sam: Suggest we do an EU-west micro-canary first (5% constrained to region) for one step, then expand. If the region is fine for 20m, proceed to global 25%.

Maria: Agree. I'll update the release note snippet for PMs with the curtain steps, rollback triggers, and the pinned-model note. Also adding contact list for a fast rollback: @Sam, @Dana, @Leo.

Dana: If a gate trips, procedure: 1) /deploybot ff set llm_route_v2 --percent 0 --force 2) /deploybot pin model_v1_locked --ttl 2h 3) open a postmortem thread with the deploy id and telemetry snapshot. Keep it short and actionable.

Leo: One more: make sure the cost/usage dashboard is marked to sample tokens for both variants — we need to catch any quality regressions asap.

Maria: Thanks everyone. I'll schedule the manual START at 02:07 UTC and call it in #eng-sre when I kick it off. Posting the release note draft below for quick copy-paste to the release doc.

Maria (release-note-draft): "Rolling rollout: `llm_route_v2` curtain-raise (5% -> 25% -> 100%). Health gates: p95 latency +120ms, errors +0.5% abs, drops +0.2% abs. Rollback: deploy-bot command to set percent 0 and pin `model_v1_locked` for 2h. Session affinity set to 5m during rollout. EU-west micro-canary first. Contact: Sam, Dana, Leo."

Ben: :thumbsup: ready on my side to execute the commands once you give the START.

deploy-bot: reminder scheduled for 02:07 UTC. I will wait for explicit START to begin the curtain steps. All actions will be logged to /var/log/deploybot/ff-rollouts and posted here on each transition.

Maria: Great — starting drumbeat. If no objections before 01:55 UTC, I’ll lock the plan and post the release note.
